l-e-m2-b06-15.material: A teacher na person wey teach. A painter na person wey paint. A farmer na person wey farm. Find the rule and guess wetin runner mean.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s1.r.b: -er no get negative meaning. E mean person wey do am.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s1.r.c: -er show the person wey do something, no be time.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s1.explain: -er after verb add meaning “person wey do that.” Runner na person wey dey run.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: For the examples, -er add meaning of person wey dey do am, so runner na person wey dey run.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s2.model.1: Since -er after teach, paint, and farm show one person, -er after run too mean person wey dey run.

l-e-m2-b07-03.title: Comparative of adjective wey end with -y
l-e-m2-b07-03.goal: Find the rule from some examples of comparative and superlative of adjectives wey end with -y, state am, and check am with new example.
l-e-m2-b07-03.material: happy → happier → happiest. easy → easier → easiest. busy → busier → busiest. Find the rule from the examples and use am with funny.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: Which comparative and superlative of funny correct?
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: You leave y and only add -er and -est.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.b: You use more/most instead of rule for -y adjectives.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: You leave y, add i, and even mix the spelling.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.explain: If word end with consonant + y, change y to i and add -er and -est.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: For happy, easy, and busy, y change to i and dem add -er, so funny too become funnier and funniest.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: For all three examples, y change to i to make -ier and -iest, so funny follow the same rule.

l-e-m2-b02-33.s.s2.model.1: Past tense only tell when person lose am, so the situation now no clear; that mean B give stronger feeling.
